project.name: voicebox
project.description: Voicebox is a local-first AI voice studio — clone voices, generate speech in 23 languages across 7 TTS engines, dictate with global hotkeys.

nodes.summary: Unified backend abstraction layer with TTS/STT/LLM protocol definitions, model config registry, and engine factory functions. Defines TTSBackend, STTBackend, LLMBackend protocols and registers 9 TTS engines (Qwen, LuxTTS, Chatterbox, TADA, Kokoro, Fish Speech, OmniVoice) with backend-aware HF repo IDs.

Shared utilities for TTS/STT backend implementations: cache checking (is_model_cached), device detection (get_torch_device), voice prompt combination, and model loading progress tracking. Eliminates duplication across backends.

Fish Audio S2 Pro TTS backend using mlx-audio. Supports multilingual voice cloning via ref_audio, handles audio resampling to 44.1kHz, and caches voice prompts. Uses Pattern B (deferred data) for voice prompts.

HumeAI TADA TTS backend with two variants: tada-1b (English) and tada-3b-ml (multilingual). Uses flow-matching diffusion with forced-alignment encoder for 1:1 token-audio alignment. Forces CPU on macOS due to MPS incompatibilities. Patches tokenizer path to avoid gated Meta repo.

TTS generation HTTP endpoints: /generate, /generate/{id}/retry, /generate/{id}/regenerate, /generate/{id}/cancel, /generate/{id}/status (SSE), /generate/stream, /generate/import. Handles engine resolution, personality rewriting, effects chain application, and audio streaming.

Unified TTS generation orchestration with three modes: generate (full pipeline with effects), retry (re-run failed), regenerate (new version with variation). Handles model loading, voice prompt creation, chunked TTS, normalization, effects, and version management.

Voice profile management: CRUD operations, sample management, avatar processing, voice prompt creation. Supports three profile types: cloned (audio samples), preset (engine-specific voices), designed (AI-generated from text). Manages profile caching and cache invalidation.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Root React component. Detects dictate view mode vs main app. Shows loading screen during Tauri server startup with animated messages and error handling.

nodes.name: MainApp
nodes.summary: Main app shell. Handles Tauri server lifecycle (auto-start, health-check polling fallback), platform lifecycle callbacks, loading screen, then renders RouterProvider.

nodes.name: isVoiceboxHealthResponse
nodes.summary: Validates a HealthResponse has the expected Voicebox shape (status=healthy, model_loaded boolean, gpu_available boolean). Prevents misidentifying unrelated services on the same port.

nodes.name: isPortInUseError
nodes.summary: Detects port-in-use errors to distinguish between an externally-running server (health-check polling) vs a real startup failure.

nodes.name: router
nodes.summary: TanStack Router instance. Root layout wraps AppFrame > Sidebar + Outlet. Routes: /, /stories, /story-flow, /voices, /captures, /effects, /models, /settings/* sub-routes.

nodes.name: RootLayout
nodes.summary: Root layout component. Subscribes to generation progress SSE, monitors active downloads, renders AppFrame with Sidebar + Outlet, and a global Toaster.

nodes.name: DownloadToastRestorer
nodes.summary: Restores download toast notifications for any active tasks on app load.

nodes.name: ApiClient
nodes.summary: HTTP API client for all backend endpoints. ~60 methods covering: health, profiles CRUD + samples/avatar/export/import, speech generation, history, captures, settings, MCP bindings, model management, CUDA backend, stories CRUD + items, effects/presets, story-flow. Reads serverUrl from serverStore.

nodes.name: formatErrorDetail
nodes.summary: Normalizes FastAPI/Pydantic error detail shapes (string, array of {msg}, or object {message}) into a single human-readable string.

nodes.name: useGenerationForm
nodes.summary: React Hook. Manages generation form with Zod schema (text, language, seed, modelSize, engine, instruct, personality). Handles model download detection, engine-to-modelName mapping, effects chain composition, form submission, and toast notifications.

nodes.name: generationSchema
nodes.summary: Zod schema for GenerationFormValues. Fields: text (1-50000), language (LANGUAGE_CODES enum), seed, modelSize (1.7B/0.6B/1B/3B), instruct, engine (10 engines), personality.

nodes.name: useGeneration
nodes.summary: TanStack Query useMutation hook. Calls apiClient.generateSpeech(), invalidates history query on success.

nodes.name: useGenerationStore
nodes.summary: Zustand store for generation lifecycle. Tracks pendingGenerationIds (Set), isGenerating (derived), pendingStoryAdds (Map<generationId, storyId>), activeGenerationId.

nodes.name: GenerationState
nodes.summary: Interface: pendingGenerationIds, isGenerating, pendingStoryAdds Map, activeGenerationId. Actions: add/removePendingGeneration, add/removePendingStoryAdd, setActiveGenerationId.

nodes.name: FloatingGenerateBox
nodes.summary: Floating generation panel. Textarea + language/engine/effects selectors + compose/personality/instruct toggles + generate button. Syncs form with selectedProfile. Tracks pending story adds. Responsive positioning on /stories vs other routes.

nodes.name: composeMutation
nodes.summary: useMutation: calls apiClient.composeWithPersonality(selectedProfileId) to generate an in-character utterance for the textarea.

nodes.name: ENGINE_OPTIONS
nodes.summary: Const array of 12 engine+modelSize options: qwen 1.7B/0.6B, qwen_custom_voice 1.7B/0.6B, luxtts, chatterbox, chatterbox_turbo, tada 1B/3B, kokoro, fish_speech, omnivoice.

nodes.name: ENGINE_DESCRIPTIONS
nodes.summary: Record mapping each engine to a human-readable one-liner description.

nodes.name: CLONING_ENGINES
nodes.summary: Set of engines that support cloned (reference audio) profiles: qwen, luxtts, chatterbox, chatterbox_turbo, tada, fish_speech, omnivoice.

nodes.name: applyEngineSelection
nodes.summary: Parses engine:modelSize selector value, updates form engine/modelSize/language fields. Handles English-only forced reset for luxtts/chatterbox_turbo and TADA 1B.

nodes.name: EngineModelSelector
nodes.summary: React component. Dropdown select listing available engine/modelSize options filtered by selectedProfile compatibility. Auto-selects first option if current is incompatible.

nodes.name: getEngineDescription
nodes.summary: Returns ENGINE_DESCRIPTIONS[engine] or empty string.

nodes.name: isProfileCompatibleWithEngine
nodes.summary: Checks profile.voice_type: preset voices must match preset_engine; cloned voices must be in CLONING_ENGINES set.

nodes.name: getAvailableOptions
nodes.summary: Filters ENGINE_OPTIONS by profile compatibility using isProfileCompatibleWithEngine.

nodes.name: getSelectValue
nodes.summary: Maps engine + modelSize form values to the combined selector value string (e.g. 'qwen:1.7B').

tour.title: React Form Hook
tour.description: Entry point for user input. The useGenerationForm hook validates engine, text, and profile selection, then calls apiClient.generateSpeech(). It manages both form state and async generation status, centralizing validation logic so UI components stay purely presentational.
tour.languageLesson: React custom hooks encapsulate reusable stateful logic. This pattern keeps UI components declarative while business rules live in reusable, testable hooks.

tour.title: API Client
tour.description: The ApiClient provides 60+ typed methods wrapping backend endpoints. generateSpeech() sends the POST /generate request and handles all network serialization and response parsing. It is the sole boundary between the React frontend and the FastAPI backend.
tour.languageLesson: Centralized API clients use a typed fetch wrapper to ensure the frontend and backend stay in sync. Request/response types mirror Pydantic models on the server, giving compile-time safety end-to-end.

tour.title: FastAPI Route
tour.description: POST /generate receives the TTS request. It validates the voice profile exists and enqueues a generation task. This layer handles HTTP concerns: request parsing, validation, and response formatting. The actual work is delegated to the service layer.
tour.languageLesson: FastAPI uses Python decorators (@router.post) to define routes. Pydantic models auto-validate request bodies and generate OpenAPI schemas, giving free documentation and type safety.

tour.title: Generation Service
tour.description: The orchestration layer. run_generation() chains: load the TTS backend, create a voice prompt from the profile, generate speech, and save audio to disk. This coordinates multiple subsystems without knowing the details of any single one.
tour.languageLesson: The orchestrator pattern sequences multiple components, keeping business logic modular and testable. Each step is a clean function call; swapping an engine only changes the backend, not the service.

tour.title: Profile Service
tour.description: create_voice_prompt_for_profile() loads audio samples associated with a voice profile and formats them into a voice prompt dict. The prompt format is engine-specific — this service adapts profile data into whatever format the TTS backend expects.
tour.languageLesson: Voice prompts are structured dicts mapping audio paths to metadata. This abstraction lets the same interface work across different TTS engines, each with their own prompt format.

tour.title: Backend Factory
tour.description: Engine factory — get_tts_backend_for_engine('fish_speech') returns the appropriate TTSBackend implementation. It defines the TTSBackend protocol that all engine implementations must satisfy, decoupling the orchestration layer from specific model APIs.
tour.languageLesson: The factory pattern eliminates if/else chains for engine selection. New engines are added by implementing TTSBackend without touching existing code — the open/closed principle in practice.

tour.title: Fish Speech Backend
tour.description: FishAudioTTSBackend implements TTSBackend using mlx-audio's Model.generate() with voice cloning. This is the actual ML inference layer — it takes text plus a voice prompt and returns raw audio. Voice cloning works by conditioning the model on short reference audio samples captured by the profile service.
tour.languageLesson: The backend uses Apple's MLX framework for hardware-accelerated inference on Apple Silicon. The model is cached in memory between requests for low-latency generation.

tour.title: Chunked TTS for Long-Form Audio
tour.description: For long texts, generate_chunked() splits text at sentence boundaries, generates audio per chunk, then crossfades the chunks together to produce seamless output. Not every request goes through this path — only texts exceeding a length threshold. Crossfading prevents audio artifacts at chunk boundaries.
tour.languageLesson: Sentence-boundary splitting respects natural prosodic units, preventing awkward mid-sentence cuts. Crossfade is a linear gain ramp at chunk edges — a simple but effective audio signal processing technique.
